site.name: Hanoi Guide
site.tagline: A trilingual travel guide to Hanoi
hero.title: Discover Hanoi your own way
hero.subtitle: A thousand years of history, old streets, street food and stories waiting for you.
hero.imgAlt: Hoan Kiem Lake seen from above
hero.imgAlt2: Gate of the Temple of Literature
weather.title: Hanoi weather
home.places.title: Top places
home.places.desc: The sights you should not miss on a first visit to Hanoi.
home.food.title: What to eat today?
home.food.desc: Famous eateries with GrabFood and ShopeeFood ordering buttons.
home.itin.title: Suggested itineraries
home.itin.desc: Pick a sample plan, then edit it to suit you.
home.chat.title: Ask the Hanoi Guide assistant
home.chat.desc: Ask about ticket prices, opening hours, food near you, or have it build your itinerary. Answers in Vietnamese, English and Chinese.
places.title: Top places
places.pageDesc: Historic sites, the Old Quarter, museums, lakes and parks. Filter by type or find places near you.
places.empty: No places match. Try removing a filter.
food.title: What to eat in Hanoi
food.pageDesc: Pho, bun cha, egg coffee and bia hoi. Open Google Maps to get there or order delivery.
history.title: Timeline of Thang Long and Hanoi
history.pageDesc: From the 1010 edict moving the capital to the modern city, through its key milestones.
itinerary.title: My itinerary
itinerary.pageDesc: Drag to reorder, see estimated cost and time, and open the route in Google Maps.
itinerary.empty: Nothing yet. Add places from the Places page, pick a sample plan below, or ask the chatbot.
itinerary.confirmReplace: Replace your current itinerary with this sample plan?
itinerary.overpacked: This day is packed (over 8 hours). Consider removing a stop.
itinerary.samplesDesc: Load a sample plan and customise it.
hotels.title: Where to stay in Hanoi
hotels.pageDesc: Hotels, hostels and homestays by area and budget. Pick your dates and every booking button opens with your dates and guests filled in.
hotels.empty: No stays match these filters. Try another area or budget.
hotels.disclaimer: Prices are indicative. Press a booking button to see live prices for your dates. This site does not process bookings or payments.
chat.title: Ask Hanoi Guide
chat.welcome: Hi! I'm your Hanoi travel assistant. Where would you like to go or eat today?
chat.error: Sorry, the chatbot is having trouble. Please try again later.
chat.q1: What to eat in the Old Quarter?
footer.about: University course project: a Hanoi travel guide built with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, free APIs and an AI chatbot.
footer.text: Reference data. Prices and opening hours may change.
intro.hint: Drag to spin the globe. Tap Hanoi to begin.
trip.title: Itinerary
trip.emptyHint: Press "Add to itinerary" on any place or eatery.
